name: replay
help:
pullboard replay <table> [--days N] [--against <tag>]  how often a move table agrees with the moves the board recorded, with each disagreement's event id; with --against, also how the release tag's table and the current one each fared; read-only
  pullboard replay --all --against <tag|last> [--days N] [--json] [--fail-on-drift]  judges every current move table against one release (last is the newest vX.Y.Z tag), then says drifted or clean (--fail-on-drift exits 1 on drift); needs moves.judgeByRelease on; read-only
